_gram:
[{#asti, AsIt, astu, syAt#}; defective in non-conjugational
 tenses, its forms being made up from the root {#BU#}.]

_meanings:
(with <ab>loc.</ab> or an <ab>adv.</ab> of place)
.²1 to be in anything.
.²2 to belong to, be closely connected with.

.²1 to belong to, to fall to oneʼs share; {#yanmamamABizyAt#} <ls>Sk.</ls>
.²2 to be over.
.²3 to excel, surpass.
.²4 to domineer or to tyrannize over, rule over.
to arise, spring up, be visible; {#AcAryakaM vijayi mAnmaTamAvirAsIt#} <ls>Māl. 1. 26</ls>.
to be near to or in.

.²1 to be in the way.
.²2 to surpass.
.²3 to pass or spend (time).
.²4 to pervade.

.²1 to be in front of.
.²2 to be in extraordinary degree, to preponderate, excel, surpass.

.²1 to be equal to, be a match for.
.²2 to rival, emulate, vie with.
.²3 to be a representative of, stand in place of.

(<ab>Ātm.</ab> {#vyatihe, vyatise#}; {#vyatiste#}) to excel, surpass,
 be above or superior to, out-weigh; {#anyo vyatiste tu mamApi DarmaH#} <ls>Bk. 2. 35</ls>.

.²1 To throw, cast, hurl, discharge, shoot (with <ab>loc.</ab> of the mark); {#haste#}
 {#biBarzyastave#} <ls>Śvet. Up. 3. 6</ls>; {#tasminnAsTadizIkAstram#} <ls>R. 12. 23</ls>;
 <ls>Bk. 15. 91</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">14. 77</ls>; sometimes with <ab>dat.</ab> or <ab>gen.</ab> {#dasyave hetimasya#} <ls>Rv. 1. 103. 3</ls>.
.²2 To drive away. remove.
.²3 To frighten or scare away.
.²4 To throw or take away, let go, leave, give up; as in {#astamAna, astaSoka#},
 {#astakopa#} see {#asta#}.
.²5 To fight with; {#yuyoDa valirindreRa tArakeRa guho'syata#} <ls>Bhāg. 8. 10. 28</ls>.
--{%With%} {#ati#} to shoot beyond or at, overpower (with arrows);
 {#atyasta#} having shot beyond, having surpassed or excelled; joined in
 <ab>acc.</ab> (<ab>Tat. comp.</ab>; <ls>P. II. 1. 24.</ls>)
to throw over or upon, hurl at.

.
.²1 To go.
.²2 To take or receive, seize.
.²3 To shine (The examples usually cited to illustrate this sense are:--
 {#nizpraBaSca praBurAsa BUBftAm#} <ls>R. 11. 81</ls>; {#tenAsa lokaH pitfmAn vinetrA#} <ls n="R.">14. 23</ls>;
 {#lAvaRya utpAdya ivAsa yatnaH#} <ls>Ku. 1. 35</ls>. But the sense of {#didIpe#}
 or ‘shone’ is far-fetched, though Vāmana is disposed to take it. It seems
 preferable to regard {#Asa#} in these instances as equivalent to {#baBUva#},
 either taking it, as Śākaṭāyana does, as an indeclinable {#tiNantapratirUpakamavyayam#},
 or considering it, as Vallabha does, as an ungrammatical form used against
 the rules of grammar, {#prAmAdikaH prayogaH#}; see <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Ku. 1. 35</ls>).
